name: @lattice/example-endless
description: ENDLESS — a world with no edge. Chunks are minted from the seed as you reach them, evicted behind you, and identical when you come back.
$comment: Five of nine, and the four that are absent are absent for reasons. @lattice/sim has no economy: there is nothing to earn here. @lattice/persist is the one that is a finding — an endless world is exactly the shape that wants a save, and docs/GALLERY.md forbids a row a state that outlives the tab, so the pin below is a session-lifetime stand-in for what a game would write down. @lattice/audio is silent for the gallery's reason: nothing may make noise before a visitor has touched it. @lattice/input is here through the shared bootstrap rather than by name, because the pan is the whole interaction.
